items.text:
Hold a key (with any mods), tap a memory pad: saved, over whatever was there. Tap it later alone: the chord plays, as a key would (perform mode, bass, voicing as saved).
Delete held + a memory pad: cleared. A step held + a memory pad: the step gets that chord.

items.name: C. A step held: edit it
items.description: Step 9 held: its chord on the screen, the knobs are the step's (as the FM-1's loop editor, Step + Trig pages in one). Play a key or a memory now: the step gets it.

meta.label: FM-1 / CHORDS
meta.function: RemoteFM1's (not claimed): Track 1 cycles FM-1 mode and this takeover.
meta.click: Back to FM-1 mode (again: the takeover)
meta.hold: RemoteFM1's Shift layer (FM-1 mode only)

meta.label: MIDI
meta.function: RemoteFM1's (not claimed): Track 2's mode, as ever.
meta.shift: Back + Track 1..3: the firmware slots

meta.label: CONTROL

meta.shift: Back + Track 1..3: the firmware slots

meta.label: SEQ
meta.function: RemoteFM1's (not claimed): Track 4's mode, as ever.
meta.shift: Back + Track 1..3: the firmware slots

meta.label: MASTER
meta.function: RemoteFM1's (not claimed): the master volume.
meta.touch: Touched + Back: out of any takeover to FM-1 mode

meta.label: BACK
meta.function: Closes a popup or the Prog layout. Touch Volume + Back: FM-1 mode.
meta.click: Close / up one level (sent at release: Back + Track switches slots)
meta.description: ChoralRoot claims the buttons but not the Track buttons, so the host gives Back at its release.

meta.label: LAYOUT

meta.click: Quick tap: the previous layout (flips between the last two)
meta.hold: Held: the pads become the picker: layouts, the 8 memory banks, the 16 progressions

meta.label: SOUND
meta.function: The chord sound, by name (popup).
meta.shiftTurn: The engine (FM6, FM TONE, VA, CZ-1, P5, WHEEL, GRAIN)
meta.touch: The sound's name

meta.label: SEQ PLAY
meta.function: The sequencer (the looper's slot): play / stop from step 1.
meta.shift: Shift + Play: restart from step 1

meta.label: SEQ REC
meta.function: Records what is played into the loop, live, in the record mode (Overwrite, Advance, Overdub, Replace, Step).
meta.shift: Shift + Rec: the next record mode

meta.label: LATCH
meta.function: LATCH: chords keep sounding after the pads are let go.

meta.label: LOCK
meta.function: LOCK: the chord keys held now stay lit (latched); the roots play them.

meta.label: BASS
meta.function: The bass part on / off.
meta.shift: The bass sound's popup

meta.label: CLEAR / PANIC
meta.function: Held + a step: clears it. Held + a memory pad: clears it. Tapped alone: PANIC (all notes off, here and to every routed firmware).

meta.label: SHIFT

meta.function: The root pads an octave down (-2..+2).
